title.zh: 获取上传边缘函数测试代码上传信息

descriptions.zh:
- 上传一次边缘函数ER的测试代码，生成一个版本号，占用一个CodeRev的代码版本数，仅用作测试使用。
- 一个边缘函数ER最多保留10个版本号，超出限制后需要手动调用DeleteRoutineCodeRevision删除无用的版本。
descriptions.en:
*   Every time the code of a routine is released to the staging environment, a version number is generated. Such code is for tests only.
*   A routine can retain a maximum of 10 code versions. If the number of versions reaches the limit, you must call the DeleteRoutineCodeRevision operation to delete unwanted versions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa get-routine-staging-code-upload-info --name test-routine1 --code-description the_description_of_code --region cn-hangzhou
